messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a single long-running recompute from billing-prod is occupying 8/10 backfill slots and pushing EU aggregate recomputes out ~12h. Can we discuss preemption/slot granularity?

kevin: ugh. saw that too in the dashboard. current slots are coarse (1 slot == 2 GPU-hours). billing's job is huge so it ends up monopolizing.

ashwin: quick idea: add slot_granularity config so jobs can request fractional slots (0.1) and scheduler slices time more fairly. avoids full preemptions.

lucy: fractional slots sound promising but may increase scheduler churn. also need to ensure kernel warmup cost doesn't blow out latency/cost.

maria: agreed re churn. another option: tenant_isolation policies — reserved min slots for smaller tenants + max_burst for large ones. then console shows per-tenant reserved capacity.

kevin: +1. could do hybrid: fractional slots + tenant reservations. For emergency we should also support a soft-preempt flag that pauses low-priority replays and lets high-priority short jobs run.

samir: sketch of a policy we used internally before:
```json
{
  "priority": "weighted",
  "weights": {"billing-prod": 1, "eu-agg": 3, "internal": 2},
  "min_reserved": {"eu-agg": 0.5},
  "preemptible": ["internal", "batch-low"]
}
```
Not perfect but cheap to implement.

ashwin: if we add a `preemptible` tag, replay controller needs to checkpoint more frequently. current backfills checkpoint every 6h; make it configurable per-job (e.g., checkpoint_every: 15m).

maria: good call. cheaper to do checkpointing than to abort. We should also show estimated completion ETA in console and a "repriority" action button to move a job into a fast lane (requires approval).

lucy: UX point: if we expose "repriority" we need audit logs and an approval flow (maybe 2-click: nominate -> approve). ops team will want traceability.

kevin: telemetry change: emit job_slot_usage, preemption_count, checkpoint_latency per job into telemetry. Add graph to per-route dashboard.

replay-bot: deploy plan created: patch scheduler to accept fractional slots + preemptible flag + per-job checkpoint config. Dry run in staging on Thursday 03:00 UTC.

maria: timeline:
- this week: add telemetry metrics + console placeholder for ETA
- next week: scheduler fractional slots + preemptible flag + checkpoint config
- staging dry run Thu 03:00 UTC
- production toggle after canary

samir: one more: quota accounting. we must ensure billing tokens charged fairly when using fractional slots. Recommend we bill by GPU-minute consumed (already available) not by slot unit.

kevin: agree — billing by GPU-min avoids surprises. also add a safety cap: max_runtime_per_job default 72h.

maria: action items: @ashwin prototype slot_granularity in scheduler (PR by Wed), @lucy mockup console repriority/ETA (design by Wed), @kevin add telemetry metrics & billing adjustments (instrumentation PR).

ashwin: will do. starting with a simple token-bucket approach for fractional scheduling.

lucy: mockups incoming later today, will include a small timeline widget and an "escalate" CTA that opens approval modal.

kevin: I'll add telemetry dashboards and put alerts if preemption_count > 3 for a tenant in 1h.

maria: thanks team. follow-ups in #eng-platform-checkins tomorrow. :thumbsup:

replay-bot: scheduled dry-run job: staging/replay-dryrun-1746545000 (Thu 03:00 UTC). Logs will be posted to /replays/staging/1746545000.
